title: No deal shape meets the strategic-fit threshold
notes: Design section A.4 [rbd 1.1]: RECYCLE semantics, not Kill — the need returns to the scouting funnel (P0) with the screen's written feedback. The registry action vocabulary (halt / mark_conditional / escalate_to_risk_officer) has no Recycle member, so the closest action is mark_conditional and the recycle routing lives in this note plus the P1 step description (written feedback on every rejection). Declared in YAML, not yet executable — predicate null by design until the strategic-fit thresholds exist (ADR-0052 open question d).
